why.orders: You get this email because you have an order on ShopNexus.
why.account: Account emails are always sent, even with order emails turned off.
money.seller: The carrier pays you 1–2 days after the buyer receives the item.
cod.subject: %s chose cash on delivery for %s
cod.title: %s chose cash on delivery
cod.lead: Make the order to ship the item. The buyer checks it before paying the courier.
shipped.subject: %s shipped %s
shipped.title: %s shipped your order
shipped.lead: Check the item when the courier arrives, and pay only if it is right.
delivered.subject: %s was delivered. Review %s
delivered.title: Your order was delivered
delivered.lead: How was %s as a seller? Rate them so the next buyer knows.
received.subject: %s received %s
received.title: %s received the item
received.lead: The order is done. Review the buyer when you have a moment.
failed.subject: %s could not be delivered
failed.title: Delivery failed
failed.lead: The order could not be delivered. You pay nothing.
failed.lead.seller: The buyer did not take the parcel. It is on its way back to you.
failed.note.seller: The carrier charges both legs of shipping to your account.
cancelled.title: Order cancelled
cancelled.shipped_to_another: %s went to another buyer, so your order was cancelled.
cancelled.listing_closed: %s is no longer for sale, so your order was cancelled.
cancelled.seller_timeout: The seller did not ship %s, so your order was cancelled.
cancelled.seller_timeout.seller: You did not make the order for %s, so it was cancelled.
cancelled.pickup_timeout: The carrier did not pick up %s, so the order was cancelled.
cancelled.note: You paid nothing, so there is nothing to refund.
suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.lead: You can still see listings and orders, but you cannot post, message or make offers for now.
suspended.note: If you think this is a mistake, send a support request with your explanation.
unsuspended.title: Your account is active again
unsuspended.lead: You can post, message and make offers again.
